app.name: Quizbrew
error.noQuiz: No quiz yet. Wait for the quizmaster.
error.colorTaken: That colour is taken. Pick another one.
screen.idle: The quizmaster is setting up. Grab a drink!
host.pickQuizHint: Open a quiz, then let the teams scan the QR code on the big screen.
host.lobbyTitle: {n} team is in|{n} teams are in
host.noTeams: No teams yet. They scan the QR code on the big screen.
host.confirmStop: Stop this quiz? The scores will be lost.
play.noQuiz: No quiz yet. The quizmaster is setting up.
play.tooLate: The quiz has already started. Ask the quizmaster.
play.youreIn: You're in! Look at the big screen.
play.locked: Answer locked in. Look at the big screen.
round.open.desc: Type the answer; the quizmaster can overrule.
round.closest.desc: Guess a number. The closest team scores, spot on counts double.
round.picture.desc: What or who is in the picture?
round.zoomOut.desc: The picture starts zoomed in far and slowly zooms out. Early is worth more.
round.speed.desc: Ten seconds a question. Fast answers score more.
round.scramble.desc: The letters are shuffled. Find the word.
round.commonThread.desc: Clues appear one by one. What links them? Early is worth more.
round.jackpot.desc: See the category, bet your points, then answer. Wrong loses the bet.
scoring.points.desc: Right = the points of the question.
scoring.speed.desc: Right = points, plus up to double for a fast answer.
scoring.race.desc: Only the fastest right team scores.
scoring.risk.desc: Right = plus points, wrong = minus points. No answer = 0.
scoring.time.desc: Right = the seconds left on the clock.
scoring.ladder.desc: The earlier you know it, the more points.
scoring.own.closest: Scoring: the closest team gets the points, spot on counts double.
scoring.own.jackpot: Scoring: right wins the bet, wrong or no answer loses it.
twist.double.desc: Every point in this round counts twice.
twist.lockdown.desc: Leave the quiz page during a question and that answer is blocked.
twist.blackout.desc: Phones only show the letters; the question is on the TV only.
twist.underdog.desc: The last team in the standings gets 1.5 times the points.
screen.typeAnswer: Type your answer on your phone
screen.typeNumber: Type a number on your phone
screen.betHint: Bet your points on your phone. Right wins the bet, wrong loses it.
play.blocked: You left the quiz page. This answer is blocked.
play.betPlaced: Bet placed: {n}. You can still change it.
play.betMax: You can bet up to {n} points.
play.jokerConfirm: Use your only joker on this round? Every point counts double.
play.jokerPlayed: Joker played! This round counts double for you.
host.builderHint: Prepare a whole quiz night: rounds, pictures, AI help.
host.judgeHint: Tap ✓ or ✗ to overrule a typed answer.
builder.title: Quiz builder
builder.emptyLibrary: No quizzes yet. Start a new one.
builder.welcomeHint: Pick rounds from a big menu, fill them yourself or let the AI help, and play when you are ready.
builder.noRounds: This quiz has no rounds yet.
builder.confirmDeleteRound: Delete this round and its questions?
builder.confirmDeleteFolder: Delete this folder and every quiz in it?
builder.copySample: Samples cannot be changed. Make a copy in your library?
builder.moveFailed: Could not move or rename. Maybe that name already exists.
builder.importFailed: This file could not be imported.
builder.uploadFailed: This picture could not be added.
builder.f.question: Question
builder.f.cluesHint: They appear one by one during the question.
builder.f.addImage: Drop a picture here, click, or paste
ai.noKeyYet: No key yet. Add one under AI keys, or use the copy-prompt way.
ai.withoutKeyHint: Copy the prompt, paste it in any AI chat, then paste the answer here.
ai.keyPrivacy: Your key stays on this laptop. Only AI help needs internet.
ai.noJson: No questions found in the text. Paste the whole AI answer.
ai.noQuestions: The AI answer had no usable questions.
ai.badKey: The key is not valid. Check it under AI keys.
ai.badModel: This model does not exist (anymore). Pick another one under AI keys.
ai.noCredit: No credit left on this AI account.
ai.busy: The AI is too busy right now. Try again in a minute.
ai.timeout: The AI took too long. Try again.
ai.offline: No internet connection. AI help needs internet.
ai.refused: The AI would not write this. Change the topic.
ai.empty: The AI gave an empty answer. Try again.
ai.failed: Something went wrong with the AI.
